context: SNME (5/23) go-home show. Outlet-reconciled (WWE.com, PWTorch x2, Cageside, WrestleView, PWMania, Fightful, Ringside, WrestlingInc, Yahoo) -- corrects the live markers on four points: Solo BEAT Priest (not the reverse) and NO Fatal Four Way exists; only ONE women's tag match (the 'Flair & Bliss vs FI' was the opening promo); no contract signing or 'typical American' promo this night (both were 5/29); the Aldis/Robinson 'Chinese' whisper is a Danhausen reanimation gag with zero outlet support (NOT canonized).

segments.outcome: Rhea opened and accepted Jade Cargill's Women's Championship rematch for Clash in Italy. Charlotte Flair + Alexa Bliss interrupted (trust tension: Rhea was 'visiting family' during last week's attack); Fatal Influence interrupted, Jayne relishing the division 'imploding'. Set up a tag match.

Talla Tonga def. Shinsuke Nakamura via chokeslam (Solo distraction). Post-match: Tama STOPPED Solo from piling on, then attacked Nakamura HIMSELF -- claiming the enforcement role rather than refusing it. Damian Priest ran in with a steel chair to make the save.
segments.register: the brother-as-hold holds; Tama takes operational control of the family's violence

segments.outcome: Tiffany Stratton retained the Women's US Title over Lash Legend (open challenge) via roll-up. Nia Jax cornered Lash; Chelsea Green at ringside caused the opening (threw Jax into the post).

Rhea Ripley & Charlotte Flair def. Fatal Influence (Fallon Henley & Lainey Reid). Flair tagged herself in over Rhea's Riptide and STOLE the pin with Natural Selection. Post-match: Jade Cargill, Michin & B-Fab attacked; Jade hit Jaded on Rhea, faction stood tall.
segments.register: the pin-steal loads the SNME fracture; Hera-record-track Flair claims the moment

segments.outcome: Trick Williams retained the US Title over Carmelo Hayes (~13 min) via Trick Shot, after Ricky Saints interfered/distracted Hayes. Post-match Hayes attacked Saints -- opening the Saints/Hayes feud. Trick also declared for King of the Ring.
segments.register: Earned-Successor holds; the dirty-mirror loses dirty (Saints chaos)

segments.outcome: Solo Sikoa def. Damian Priest via Samoan Spike with MFT interference (Tama & Talla ringside, ref distraction). Storyline: Tama told Solo to beat Priest ALONE to prove the faction isn't weak -- a strength-flex Solo requested from Aldis, NOT a #1-contender qualifier (no Fatal Four Way exists).
segments.register: Tama directs, Solo executes -- the remnant consolidates

segments.outcome: Recurring power-outage gag: Nick Aldis sent referee Charles Robinson to check the flickering lights; traced to Danhausen's backstage 'lab' (a reanimation experiment under a sheet, 'don't touch it'). Sacred-Clown chaos becoming load-bearing on the broadcast itself.
segments.register: Sacred Clown / Heyoka; the curse-is-it-real register

segments.outcome: Cody Rhodes def. Sami Zayn via Cross Rhodes (Gunther ringside interference backfired -- Sami's Helluva Kick hit Gunther). Post-match Gunther attacked Cody (powerbomb + sleeper, held the title aloft); Sami started to make the save but LEFT instead (no-save tease).
segments.register: Cronus stands tall over Telemachus on the go-home; Sami's descent via withheld rescue
